name: greatquestion
description:
Great Question puts your whole research workflow inside ChatGPT and Codex. Create research studies, recruit participants, and pull what customers said, without leaving the chat. All backed by verbatim quotes you can trace to the session.

You don't need to know which study holds the answer. Ask "What have customers said about our checkout in the last six months?" and it searches your transcripts, highlights and insights, then comes back with quotes, so everyone on your team makes research-backed decisions with confidence.

It works the other way too. Describe what you want to learn and it sets up the study, an interview, survey or prototype test, with the screener, incentive and participants ready for you to review.

Your existing Great Question permissions apply, so it only sees what you can see.

defaultPrompt: What have customers said about our checkout in the last six months?
Give me the three most common complaints about our current dashboard, with direct quotes.
Set up an interview study on why new users drop off during onboarding: 8 participants, $100 incentive each.

positive.description: Find what customers said about a topic across studies
positive.prompt: What have customers said about our checkout in the last six months?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns quotes about checkout from the demo workspace: surprise shipping costs, forced account creation, the promo code box and mobile checkout, attributed to the sessions they came from.

positive.description: Pull the most common complaints with direct quotes
positive.prompt: Give me the three most common complaints about our current dashboard, with direct quotes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns three dashboard complaints, each with a direct quote: numbers with nothing to compare against, a date range that resets, and a dashboard that does not work on a phone.

positive.description: Answer a question from an existing insight
positive.prompt: Where do new users get stuck during onboarding?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the places new stores stall: payments verification with no timeline, product import errors, and shipping zones asked for too early.

positive.prompt: Summarise the findings from our most recent prototype test.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the one-page checkout prototype test. What worked: shipping cost shown up front and guest checkout. What to change: the promo code box, the postcode field and trust cues.

positive.description: Create a new study from a research question
positive.prompt: Set up an interview study on why new users drop off during onboarding: 8 participants, $100 incentive each.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft interview study about onboarding drop-off with 8 participants and a $100 incentive, and returns a link to it. Nothing is sent to participants.

negative.description: Unrelated request. The plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in London today?

negative.description: No research exists on this topic. The plugin may search, should find nothing, and should say so instead of inventing quotes.
negative.prompt: What have customers said about our mobile app's login screen?

negative.description: The named insight does not exist. The plugin should say it was not found instead of inventing one.
negative.prompt: Show me the insight called "Pricing page feedback".

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release. Create research studies, recruit participants, and pull what customers said from Great Question, in ChatGPT and Codex.
